item.text:
`[test/orders.js](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-Qj3OBM/test/orders.js)` defines four small helpers for a shop backend:

- `calcTotal(items)`: sums `price * qty` for each item.
- `applyDiscount(total, code)`: applies a fixed percentage discount for `SAVE10` or `SAVE20`.
- `averageItemPrice(items)`: computes an average from the total.
- `formatOrder(order)`: renders item lines plus a final discounted total.

Bugs:

- `[test/orders.js:5-6](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-Qj3OBM/test/orders.js#L5)` has an off-by-one error: `i <= items.length` reads `items[items.length]`, which is `undefined`, so `items[i].price` can throw on the last loop.
- `[test/orders.js:18-20](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-Qj3OBM/test/orders.js#L18)` divides by `items.length`, so an empty array returns `NaN`/`Infinity` instead of a sensible value or a clear error.
- `[test/orders.js:18-20](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-Qj3OBM/test/orders.js#L18)` is also semantically shaky: it averages by line item count, not by quantity, so one item with `qty: 10` counts the same as one with `qty: 1`.
- `[test/orders.js:23-26](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-Qj3OBM/test/orders.js#L23)` assumes `order.items` always exists and is an array; bad input will crash.

If you want, I can also propose a minimal patch for the broken functions.
